classDiagram
  class Shape {
    <<abstract>>
    +draw() void
  }
  class Circle {
    +radius int
    +draw() void
  }
  Shape <|-- Circle
---

    | <<abstract>>   |
    | Shape          |
    +----------------+
    |                |
    +----------------+
    | + draw(): void |
    +----------------+
            ^
            |
            |
            |
            |
            |
            |
            |

    | Circle         |
    +----------------+
    | +radius int    |
    +----------------+
    | + draw(): void |
